name: – After recital N – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: Na. whereas, in such a context, a single incident causing casualties on EU territory or involving a warship of a NATO Member State could trigger mutual defence mechanisms and lead to a direct military confrontation between NATO and the Russian Federation, two nuclear-armed powers, with catastrophic consequences for the peoples of Europe and the world;
